text: 小红书：上半年来配合警方抓捕以批量造假注册文旅票务、房地产、金融等行业专业号黑灰产团队四个，嫌疑人共计14名
text_en: Xiaohongshu: In the first half of this year, it assisted police in arresting four black-market teams that used batch forgery to register professional accounts in industries such as cultural tourism ticketing, real estate, and finance, involving 14 suspects in total
